slice: SE ROUTE CORRIDOR — the stops BETWEEN central Saigon and Vũng Tàu: Long Thành/Nhơn Trạch (Đồng Nai) → Bà Rịa/Long Điền → Vũng Tàu → the coastal extension Long Hải → Hồ Tràm → Hồ Cốc/Bình Châu (Xuyên Mộc). Kept SEPARATE from all other *_HCMC_*.json source files.

outlets.name: VnExpress (Du lịch)
outlets.note: Vietnam's largest online newspaper; dedicated features on lẩu cá đuối and bánh canh Long Hương.

outlets.name: Viet Nam News (VNA English daily)
outlets.note: National English-language daily; 'Stingray hotpot – Vũng Tàu's popular specialty'.

outlets.name: Tuổi Trẻ
outlets.note: Major national daily; salted-egg sponge cake feature.

outlets.name: Vietcetera
outlets.note: Leading VN English media; 'Vung Tau – A Magnet For The Weekend Crowd'.

outlets.name: Travelfish
outlets.note: Long-running independent SE-Asia travel guide; Vũng Tàu eat listings.

outlets.name: Sài Gòn Tiếp Thị (The Saigon Times)
outlets.note: Established Saigon lifestyle/business outlet; 'Bản đồ ẩm thực' bánh hỏi An Nhứt.

outlets.name: Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu Tourism (bariavungtautourism.com.vn)
outlets.note: Regional tourism editorial; corroborating source for BRVT specialties (never lone).

outlets.name: Chăn nuôi Việt Nam (Vietnam Animal Husbandry)
outlets.note: Trade/industry publication of the Vietnam Animal Husbandry Association; Long Thành dairy brand-development piece.

outlets.name: VietnamPlus (Vietnam News Agency)
outlets.note: VNA English service; Bạch Dinh / White Palace history.

outlets.name: Vietnam News Agency (vnanet.vn)
outlets.note: State news agency photo/feature service; White Palace & Bình Châu–Phước Bửu.

outlets.name: Wikipedia
outlets.note: Lone-authority-OK for a sight with a full article: Hòn Bà, Thích Ca Phật Đài, Bình Châu–Phước Bửu Nature Reserve.

outlets.name: Origin Vietnam
outlets.note: Tour-operator destination guides; corroborating source only (Front Beach, Hòn Bà).

outlets.name: Mia.vn
outlets.note: VN travel content site; corroborating only — Wikipedia carries the authority for Thích Ca Phật Đài.

outlets.name: Thanh Niên
outlets.note: Major national daily; Nhà Lớn Long Sơn features.

outlets.name: Dân Trí
outlets.note: Major national online daily; Nhà Lớn Long Sơn architecture.

outlets.name: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism
outlets.note: National tourism authority; Nhà Lớn (Đền Ông Trần) heritage listing.

outlets.name: Nhân Dân
outlets.note: Communist Party daily of record; Dinh Cô festival.

outlets.name: VOV World (Voice of Vietnam)
outlets.note: National broadcaster; Dinh Cô–Long Hải festival.

outlets.name: BRVT Investment, Trade & Tourism Promotion Center
outlets.note: Provincial government tourism body; Dinh Cô festival, BRVT cuisine.

outlets.name: Vietnam Coracle (Tom Divers)
outlets.note: Top independent Vietnam travel resource; dedicated Hồ Tràm/Hồ Cốc guide and the '7 Places to Eat Bánh Khọt in Vũng Tàu' feature.

outlets.name: Xuyên Mộc District Portal
outlets.note: District government portal; Bình Châu hot springs / Hồ Cốc.

outlets.name: Vietnam Airlines Travel Guide
outlets.note: National-carrier editorial guide; Hồ Tràm beach (corroborating).

outlets.name: Báo Đồng Nai
outlets.note: Đồng Nai provincial daily of record; Bò Cạp Vàng top-7 eco nomination.

outlets.name: vietnam.vn (national information portal)
outlets.note: National multi-provincial information portal; Bò Cạp Vàng eco nomination.
